name: Marketing Cloud Developer
notes: Banco de 4 pruebas reales hechas en feb 2025, unificadas sin repetidas (algunas versiones tenían 3 opciones en lugar de 4). Hay preguntas de elegir 2 o 3. Las respuestas salen de anotaciones y de lo marcado por quien hizo cada prueba: pueden contener errores y llevan una nota cuando hay duda.

questions.q: A developer wants to expand the functionality of existing code which was written in AMPscript, but prefers to use Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) for updates. Which SSJS statement would retrieve the value of the AMPscript variable named @subKey?
questions.e: En SSJS, Variable.GetValue("@nombre") lee una variable AMPscript declarada antes en el mismo contexto.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has set up their North American business unit to unsubscribe at the business unit level. Which dataview would they query to identify all subscribers who are unsubscribed from that Business Unit?
questions.e: Con bajas a nivel de unidad de negocio se consulta _BusinessUnitUnsubscribes.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to import a data file. It will be uploaded at regular intervals to their Enhanced FTP Account where an automation will import the file into a data extension. NTO requires the file to be encrypted. Which two file encryption options are supported when importing data files to Marketing Cloud?
questions.e: Los archivos importados cifrados se descifran con PGP/GPG; ambas claves se gestionan en Key Management.

questions.q: A developer wants to create a data model in Contact Builder. Which two applications will be able to use this newly-created data model for segmentation?
questions.e: El modelo de datos de Contact Builder alimenta la segmentación y la automatización.
questions.note: En Dev 4 (P9) aparece marcada: Email Studio.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters mistakenly synced the User_Salesforce object which added to their billable contact count. What should be recommended to remove these contacts?
o: Update the sync to remove these contacts from the All Contacts table.
Use the REST API to delete the contacts from the All Subscribers table.
Put the synced records into a sendable data extension and use Contact Delete.
Use the SOAP API to delete the contacts from the All Contacts table.
questions.e: Para quitar contactos sincronizados por error se meten en una data extension enviable y se usa Contact Delete.

questions.q: A developer is creating a CloudPage which accepts secure parameters via an email link and will submit those parameters to another CloudPage for data upsert. The page currently captures an Appointment ID parameter passed into it and sets the value to the variable @apptId. The developer does NOT want the Appointment ID to be visible to anyone using the form. What is the best method to ensure the parameters are passed successfully to the data upsert page?
questions.e: CloudPagesURL cifra los parámetros en la URL, de modo que el ID no queda visible para el usuario.

questions.q: A developer receives Error Code 5 when performing a SOAP API call. The error states: "Cannot Perform 'Post' on objects of type 'SentEvent'". What could be the issue?
o: It may be a temporary network issue.
'SentEvent' is not able to be updated using SOAP.
SOAP does not support POST; use REST.
questions.e: El objeto SentEvent es de solo lectura: no admite Post/Create/Update por SOAP.

questions.q: A developer wants to add an image to Content Builder via the API and retrieve the image's published URL. Which method should the developer use?
o: POST to the REST API /asset/v1/content/assets and parse the FileProperties parameter
GET using the REST API /asset/v1/content/assets and parse the FileProperties parameter
POST to the REST API /asset/v1/content/categories and parse the Description parameter
Use the SOAP API to create a Portfolio object and identify the Source property
questions.e: Content Builder se alimenta con POST a /asset/v1/content/assets; la URL pública está en FileProperties.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters puts the word TEST at the beginning of the name for each test email. Which query would return the subscribers who were sent those emails?
o: SELECT * FROM _Job J INNER JOIN _Sent S on J.JobID = S.JobID WHERE J.EmailName = 'TEST%'
SELECT * FROM _Job J INNER JOIN _Sent S on J.EmailName LIKE 'TEST%'
SELECT * FROM _Job INNER JOIN _Sent on JobID = JobID WHERE EmailName LIKE 'TEST%'
SELECT * FROM _Job J INNER JOIN _Sent S ON J.JobID = S.JobID WHERE J.EmailName LIKE 'TEST%'
questions.e: Se une _Job con _Sent por JobID y se filtra con LIKE 'TEST%' sobre EmailName (no con =).

questions.q: A developer wants to implement a newsletter registration form on Northern Trail Outfitters' website. Prior to form submission, an email address provided by the visitor should be validated. Which option could be used to support this scenario?
o: SOAP API, Describe method with EmailAddress object
SOAP API, Perform method with ValidationAction object
questions.e: La ruta /address/v1/validateEmail valida el email antes de enviar el formulario.

questions.q: Contact Builder can be used to create a relational model of an organization's data within Marketing Cloud. Which three factors should be taken into consideration when preparing data to be used in Contact Builder?
o: Verifying each data extension has the required Email Address field populated
Verifying all data extensions have a sendable value
Assigning data relationships and primary keys across all channels
questions.e: Un buen modelo verifica que los datos sirven al marketing, define relaciones y claves y normaliza para reducir redundancia.

questions.q: A developer is building an integration with the Marketing Cloud API. In which two ways should the client ID and client secret credentials be stored?
o: Set credentials as environment variables in the application platform
Pass credentials in URL parameters over HTTPS
Set credentials as variables in application source code
Store credentials in a key management system (KMS)
questions.e: Las credenciales se guardan fuera del código: variables de entorno o un gestor de claves (KMS).

questions.q: A developer wants to aggregate monthly energy usage data over a four-month period for each subscriber within an email. The monthly usage values are stored in variables for each month in the following way: SET @jan = LOOKUP("energyusage", "jan","subscriber_key",_subscriberKey). How should AMPscript be used to generate the total?
questions.e: ADD suma de dos en dos, así que se anida: ADD(@jan,ADD(@feb,ADD(@mar,@apr))).

questions.q: An email requires custom AMPscript to append the subscriber's zip code to a link in the email. A field named zipcode already exists in the sending data extension. It is important Marketing Cloud tracks subscribers who click on the link. Which two AMPscript functions should be used in the setup?
questions.e: RedirectTo mantiene el tracking del enlace y Concat construye la URL con el código postal.

questions.q: A developer is using the REST Authorization Service to obtain an OAuth access token. Which method should be used to include the access token in the API request?
o: Include the header Authorization: Basic YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN
Include the header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN
questions.e: El token se envía en la cabecera Authorization: Bearer <token>.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has an Enterprise 2.0 account with 15 business units. Each business unit can access a Shared Data Extension named 'Inventory', which contains the details for each product. A Boolean field named 'InStock' indicates whether the item is available. Which snippet of AMPscript would return all products which are currently available?
questions.e: Las DEs compartidas se referencian con el prefijo ENT. (p. ej. LookupRows("Ent.Inventory",…)).

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters stores most of their customer data in Marketing Cloud. They do not mind their data being viewed in clear text within SFMC to users who have access, but they want to ensure the underlying database files are encrypted at rest in case the physical media is stolen. Which encryption method should be used?
questions.e: Transparent Data Encryption cifra los datos en reposo, pero los usuarios con acceso los ven en claro.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters' account is configured with two child BU(s): US and Global. The account has a data extension in the Shared Data Extensions folder named 'MemberData'. This data extension contains basic address information, as well as Boolean fields labeled 'US' and 'Global' indicating to which business unit the subscriber belongs. An automation needs to be created in the US business unit to query all records in New York who are members of the business unit US. SELECT * FROM MemberData WHERE State = 'NY' AND US = 1. What would cause this query to report the following error: "An error occurred while checking the query syntax. Errors: MemberData is not a known data extension or system data view. You can only query existing data extensions or system data views."?
o: Incorrect syntax; Query Activities are written in SOQL
MemberData should be prefixed with ENT
Query should check for a US value of 'True'
Query Activities cannot use the * wildcard
questions.e: Una DE de la carpeta compartida se consulta desde las unidades hijas con el prefijo ENT.

questions.q: A developer wants to populate a data extension with information about all emails deployed in the last seven days. The data extension needs to contain JobID, EventDate, and the counts of how many emails were sent with each JobID. Which data view is required to gather this information?
questions.e: El data view _Sent aporta JobID, fecha de envío y suscriptor de los correos enviados.

questions.q: A data extension contains two fields which are being populated by a query activity. A third field has recently been added to the data extension. Which SELECT statement would be optimal for returning all of the columns in the data extension?
questions.e: Con un campo nuevo, SELECT field1, field2, field3 lista exactamente las columnas (SELECT * puede dar problemas en la consulta).

questions.q: A developer wants to retrieve all records in the OrderDetails data extension which are associated with a particular customer. Which two AMPscript functions would return a suitable rowset?
questions.e: LookupRows y LookupOrderedRows devuelven varias filas (rowset); Lookup devuelve solo un valor.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) has an Enterprise 2.0 account; subscribers unsubscribe from the business unit only. A developer is identifying subscribers who unsubscribed from any of the NTO child business units. Which method would identify the most accurate status for subscribers of each business unit?
o: Create Data Extracts of All Subscribers within the parent business unit
Query unsubscribes from _Subscribers within the parent business unit
Create Data Extracts of All Subscribers within each child business unit
Query status from _ListSubscribers within the parent business unit
questions.e: Para bajas por unidad hay que extraer los suscriptores de cada unidad hija, no solo de la padre.

questions.q: A customer wants to export send data to their SFTP. Which two automations would accomplish this?
o: Query (Data Views) > Data Extension Extract > File Transfer
questions.e: Se exporta con Query sobre data views → Data Extension Extract → File Transfer, o con Tracking Extract → File Transfer.

questions.q: A developer receives a request to integrate Marketing Cloud with a lead capture tool. The lead capture tool will call the Marketing Cloud API to create a data extension every time a new lead form is published. The created data extension's name should match the name of the form exactly. Which API feature could be used to dynamically create these data extensions?
o: Creating the data extension using API is not possible
REST API using POST on the /data/v1/customobjectdata/ endpoint
SOAP API using Create Method and the DataExtension Object
REST API using POST on the /interaction/v1/EventDefinitions endpoint with Schema populated
questions.e: Para crear una data extension vía API se usa SOAP: Create sobre el objeto DataExtension.

questions.q: A developer is implementing a custom profile center and using the LogUnsubEvent request. Which parameter is required for the event to be tied to the appropriate send?
questions.e: LogUnsubEvent necesita JobID (y los demás datos de contexto) para vincular la baja al envío.

questions.q: A developer identified a use case where a triggered send of an email is needed. The developer already successfully set up authentication with a client ID and client secret and has used them in several REST calls. When the REST call is made, a "401 Unauthorized" error is returned. What should be checked first?
o: The send permissions have been granted for the client ID and client secret within Installed Packages.
The automation permissions have been granted for the client ID and client secret within Installed Packages.
The email interaction has been started.
The email interaction has been published.
questions.e: Un 401 con credenciales válidas indica falta de permisos de envío del paquete instalado.

questions.q: A sendable data extension with a text field named 'Balance' contains the value '$6.96' for a particular record. The following AMPscript statement is included in an email: IF (Balance > 6.00) THEN SET @Result = 'Balance is more than $6.00' ENDIF. Why would this IF statement yield unintended results?
o: The comparison should use the < operator.
The operands are not the same data type.
Double quotes should be used instead of single quotes.
questions.e: "$6.96" es texto; comparado con un número da resultados inesperados. Hay que convertir tipos o comparar como texto.
questions.note: Marcada A en el set; la lógica apunta a que los operandos son de distinto tipo (C). Verificar.

questions.q: A developer needs to identify all subscribers who were sent Job ID 420 but did not click any links. Which SQL statement would produce the desired results?
o: SELECT s.SubscriberKey FROM _Sent s JOIN _Click c ON s.SubscriberKey = c.SubscriberKey AND s.JobID = c.JobID WHERE s.JobID = 420
SELECT s.SubscriberKey FROM _Sent s LEFT JOIN _Click c ON s.SubscriberKey = c.SubscriberKey AND s.JobID = c.JobID WHERE s.JobID = 420 AND c.SubscriberKey IS NULL
SELECT s.SubscriberKey FROM _Sent s JOIN _Click c ON s.SubscriberKey = c.SubscriberKey AND s.JobID = c.JobID WHERE s.JobID = 420 AND c.SubscriberKey IS NULL
SELECT s.SubscriberKey FROM _Sent s LEFT JOIN _Click c ON s.SubscriberKey = c.SubscriberKey AND s.JobID = c.JobID WHERE s.JobID = 420
questions.e: LEFT JOIN de _Sent con _Click filtrando clics nulos devuelve quienes recibieron y no hicieron clic.

questions.q: A developer wants to delete a batch of subscribers from Marketing Cloud. The developer performs a Contact Delete on a batch of records in a data extension in Contact Builder. Which scenario would cause subscriber records to remain in the data extension?
o: Non-sendable data extension with SubscriberKey field
Sendable data extension with SubscriberKey field
Contact Delete process does not delete rows from data extensions
Sendable data extension with SubscriberKey and EmailAddress fields
questions.e: Contact Delete se ejecuta sobre una DE no enviable con el SubscriberKey.

questions.q: A developer wants to retrieve a row of data from a data extension using the SOAP API. Which API Object should be used for this call?
questions.e: Las filas de una DE se recuperan con el objeto DataExtensionObject (DataExtension solo define la estructura).

questions.q: A developer needs to configure a process that can store encrypted data from Marketing Cloud as a file on an external server. What steps should the developer take?
o: Shield Platform Encryption is required for encrypted data export
Create PGP Key > Data Extract > File Transfer with PGP checked
Data from Marketing Cloud cannot be encrypted
Data Extract > File Transfer with Marketing Cloud Public Key
questions.e: Se crea una clave PGP, se extrae con Data Extract y se transfiere con File Transfer con PGP activado.

questions.q: Why would a developer use LookupRows instead of the Lookup AMPscript function?
o: To return a complete rowset from the data extension
To stay at the limit of two Lookup calls in one email
To see how many rows are in a data extension
To access a data extension, as Lookup only targets lists
questions.e: LookupRows devuelve un rowset completo; Lookup devuelve solo un valor.

questions.q: How many months of data can a developer query from the tracking data views (_Sent, _Open, _Click)?
questions.e: Los data views de seguimiento guardan unos seis meses de datos.

questions.q: A developer needs to use the /contacts/ route of the REST API to update records in a data extension. What should the developer verify before making the API call?
o: Each contact should already exist in All Subscribers.
Journey Builder should be configured to use the data extension.
Contact Key should be equal to Subscriber Key in the underlying data extensions to ensure proper joining.
The data extension should be linked in an Attribute Group in Contact Builder.
questions.e: La ruta /contacts/ exige que la DE esté enlazada en un Attribute Group de Contact Builder.

questions.q: A developer created a landing page in CloudPages which returns unique content when subscriber data is located on a related data extension. The developer does not know if all subscribers have rows in the related data extension, and wants default content to render if no subscriber data is found on the related data extension. Which best practice should the developer follow to control the unique and default content?
o: Use the RowCount function and an IF statement
Use the LookupOrderedRows and Row functions
Use the Lookup, Row, and Field functions
questions.e: RowCount + IF comprueba si hay filas antes de usar el contenido y evita errores.

questions.q: A developer wants to create a complex dynamic email with three different sections and four different possible content blocks in each section. The email will be sent to an audience of over one million contacts. Which best practice should the developer use to ensure a blank email will not be sent?
o: Send a test of every possible version using Test Send
Review every possible version using Subscriber Preview
Create separate emails for each version
Confirm every version has default content
questions.e: Cada contenido dinámico necesita una versión por defecto para cubrir a quien no cumpla las reglas.

questions.q: From which business unit could the Contact Delete feature be used within an Enterprise 2.0 account?
o: The business unit where the contact was introduced
questions.e: En Enterprise 2.0, Contact Delete se usa desde la cuenta padre.

questions.q: In what order is AMPscript evaluated before an email is sent?
o: Text Body, HTML Body, Subject Line
HTML Body, Text Body, Subject Line
HTML Body, Subject Line, Text Body
Subject Line, HTML Body, Text Body
questions.e: AMPscript se evalúa en el orden HTML, texto y asunto antes del envío.

questions.q: A developer wants to build an email that dynamically populates the physical address of a company's locations using the variable @address. The deployment goes to millions of subscribers and the developer wants the fastest possible performance. Which AMPscript solution should be recommended?
questions.e: Lookup con un único valor es la opción más rápida; LookupRows crea un rowset más pesado.

questions.q: A developer wants to transform the date and time field 'Date_Enrolled' from Daylight Savings time. How would the developer change the time to fall back one hour?
questions.e: DateAdd(fecha, -1, "H") resta una hora.

questions.q: Northern Trails Outfitters is using REST API to send emails to customers after a purchase. Which considerations should be taken regarding the token used in the API Call?
o: Make a token API call and re-use the token until the next API call fails.
Make a token API call before each triggered send API call.
Make a token API call and re-use the token for that subscriber.
Make a token API call and re-use the token until the token expires.
questions.e: El token se reutiliza hasta que caduca, no se pide uno nuevo por llamada.

questions.q: A developer is notified the View Email As Web Page (VAWP) link, when clicked, displays the message, "The system is temporarily unavailable. We apologize for any inconvenience. Please try again later." What could be a possible cause for the error?
o: The email used at the time of send was deleted, updated, or moved.
The data in the data extensions used at the time of send was overwritten.
The sender profile used at the time of send was overwritten.
The data extension used at the time of send was moved to another folder.
questions.e: El error de VAWP suele deberse a que los datos de la DE usada en el envío se han sobrescrito o borrado.

questions.q: A developer wants to create a JavaScript Web Token using a key from Key Management. What function should the developer use?
questions.e: GetJWTByKeyName() genera un JWT con una clave guardada en Key Management.

questions.q: Northern Trails Outfitters (NTO) developers want to use the Transactional Messaging API to send email receipts to customers. What is the first step required to send using the API?
o: Request a token using the v1/requestToken endpoint
Request a token using the v2/authorize endpoint
POST to /messaging/v1 with client_id and client_secret
questions.e: Primero se solicita el token de acceso (endpoint de autenticación) y luego se envía el mensaje.

questions.q: A developer needs to write AMPscript to ensure the expiration date on a coupon is the last day of the month. What would produce the desired result?
o: Find the first day of next month and subtract one day
Add 30 days using DateAdd to Now
Use the date format string for last day of month within FormatDate
Add one month using DateAdd to Now
questions.e: El último día del mes es el primero del siguiente menos un día.

questions.q: A developer created an email with an AMPscript variable as the subject line. The subject line variable was recently updated, but, when testing the email, the wrong subject line continues to appear in the inbox. The developer thinks another, outdated, subject line variable is declared within the email. Where could the outdated variable be located?
o: In the Text body which is processed after the subject line
In the HTML body which is processed after the subject line
In the Text body which is processed after the HTML body
In the HTML body which is processed after the Text body
questions.e: Un cuerpo posterior en el orden (texto) puede redefinir la variable del asunto.

questions.q: A developer needs to configure an Email Send Logging Data Extension for a new business unit. Which option should be used?
o: Create and ensure it has the name "Send Log"
Salesforce Support should create the data extension
Create using the SendLog Data Extension Template
Create from a copy of an existing Send Log in another business unit
questions.e: El Send Log se crea con la plantilla SendLog de data extension.

questions.q: A marketer from Cloud Kicks wants to make sure no email from their welcome journey gets sent to their competitor at Rainbow Run. Which two best practices should the developer use when setting up the Send Email Activity in the welcome journey?
o: Create a Filter Activity in the journey that removes the Rainbow Run domain
Create a Suppression List with all possible email addresses from Rainbow Run
Create a data extension with the Rainbow Run domain for use with a Domain Exclusion
Create an Exclusion Script with the Rainbow Run domain for use in the activity
questions.e: Se combinan una lista de supresión y un exclusion script con el dominio.

questions.q: A marketer is troubleshooting why an email send's tracking information is not available in Sales Cloud. The marketer confirms Marketing Cloud Connect is installed properly. What should be confirmed next to continue troubleshooting the send's tracking information?
o: The email was sent to the All Subscribers list.
The tracking destination folder was set to My Tracking.
The audience was a Salesforce Data Extension containing the appropriate SFID.
The audience was built using a Triggered Send Data Extension template.
questions.e: Para tracking en Sales Cloud el público debe ser una Salesforce Data Extension con el SFID.

questions.q: A developer needs to push real-time updates of the company's product catalog to a data extension. Which two API options are available?
o: Upload a file to the Enhanced SFTP for import
questions.e: Se actualiza en tiempo real con /hub/v1/dataevents (REST) o con DataExtensionObject (SOAP).

questions.q: Which AMPscript function group could most negatively impact send processing?
questions.e: Las funciones de data extension (Lookup, etc.) son las que más penalizan el rendimiento del envío.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to trigger follow up messages after a subscriber opens an email. What process would they use to get real-time engagement data?
questions.e: ENS envía en tiempo real los eventos de engagement a tu endpoint.

questions.q: A developer wants to configure performance tracking of the content dynamically created via AMPscript in an email. Which two steps should be performed to achieve this objective?
o: Add a unique identifier in the HTML tags within the generated content
Configure a reference content block in Content Builder
Include the functions BeginImpressionRegion and EndImpressionRegion
questions.e: BeginImpressionRegion/EndImpressionRegion con Impression Tracking activado miden contenido dinámico.

questions.q: A developer wants to upload a base64-encoded file to Content Builder using an API Installed Package but receives an 'Insufficient Privileges' error. What should be checked to troubleshoot the error?
o: Confirm the REST Base URI uses the correct subdomain
Validate client ID and client secret are correct
Confirm the Component's Channel options are available
Verify the Asset Type Id matches the Asset Type Name
questions.e: "Insufficient Privileges" apunta a permisos/canales del componente del paquete.
questions.note: Respuesta según anotación del set; la causa más habitual de 'Insufficient Privileges' son los permisos/scopes del Installed Package (podría ser opción C si el componente no tiene el canal habilitado). Verificar.

questions.q: A developer used LookupRows to retrieve data when building a dynamic email. What should be the next step before using this rowset within a FOR loop?
o: Use Row to return a specific row of the rowset
Set the rowset to a new array variable
Close the delimited AMPscript Code Block
Use RowCount to ensure the rowset contains data
questions.e: Antes del FOR se comprueba con RowCount que el rowset tenga filas.

questions.q: A developer is troubleshooting the cause of incomplete results in the link tracking data for an email send. How should the RedirectTo AMPscript function be described as it relates to link tracking?
o: It ensures link href values containing AMPscript variables are recorded in tracking
It ensures link href values containing HTML bookmarks or anchors are recorded in tracking
It prevents link href values from getting recorded in tracking
It ensures static link href values are recorded in tracking
questions.e: RedirectTo asegura que los enlaces con variables AMPscript se registren en el tracking.

questions.q: A developer wants to write a query to compile data originating from an HTML form so it can be exported in CSV format. However, the source data extension may contain line breaks within the Comments field, which makes it difficult to read and sort the resulting CSV. Which SQL functions could be used to change each line break to a single space?
questions.e: REPLACE(campo, CHAR(10), ' ') sustituye los saltos de línea por un espacio antes de exportar el CSV.

questions.q: Which parameter should be used to track subscriber behavior when appending data to links in Parameter Manager?
questions.e: Para vincular el comportamiento a la persona se añade el Subscriber ID a los enlaces.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to exclude sending an email at send time to those with a record on the 'Exclude' Data Extension. The primary key on this data extension is SubscriberKey. How would a developer write the Exclusion Script?
questions.e: El script debe devolver true cuando hay registro: RowCount(LookupRows(...)) > 0.

questions.q: A developer is troubleshooting why a parent-level data extension cannot be accessed by a child business unit. What should the developer check to validate the data available can be accessed for child business unit queries?
o: The data extension is in the Shared Data Extensions folder and the query includes the ENT. prefix
The data extension is in the Shared Items root folder and is accessible to the child business unit
The data extension is in the Salesforce Data Extensions folder and is accessible to the child business unit
The data extension is in the Synchronized Data Extensions folder and the query includes the ENT. prefix
questions.e: Una DE de la unidad padre se comparte en la carpeta Shared Data Extensions y se consulta con el prefijo ENT.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters' legal team is concerned about the daily import process that brings in subscribers to a Sendable Data Extension, even when records have already been targeted for deletion. Which two true expected behaviors for these records occur in the event a send is initiated directly to this Sendable Data Extension?
o: Records still in the suppression phase will only be excluded if manually specified during send time.
Records still in the suppression phase will be excluded from sends.
Records that have already been deleted will be treated as new records.
Records that have been deleted will be excluded from sends indefinitely.
questions.e: Los registros en fase de supresión se excluyen de los envíos; los ya eliminados se tratan como nuevos si se vuelven a importar.

questions.q: In which three ways should a developer optimize a query activity if it is currently timing out?
o: Use intermediate tables to stage data
Use intrinsic functions in the WHERE clause
Use primary key(s) on fields used in joins
Use SELECT * to include all fields
Only update records that have changed since last execution
questions.e: Para evitar timeouts: tablas intermedias, claves primarias en los joins y actualizar solo lo que cambió.

questions.q: A developer wants to configure an automation to import files placed on the SFTP shared by a customer's data vendor. The automation will start when a file matching a specific naming pattern is encountered in the Import folder. The first step of the automation is a File Import Activity referencing a substitution string for the matching file. Which substitution string represents the name of the file?
questions.e: La variable de sustitución del nombre del archivo que dispara el File Drop es %%FILENAME_FROM_TRIGGER%%.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters uses a number to uniquely identify contacts across different marketing channels. Which two actions should the developer take to ensure the contacts relate across channels in Marketing Cloud when working with the data model?
o: Use a unique identifier specific to each channel and automatically connect them.
Link the numeric field value to the Contact ID in Attribute Groups in Contact Builder.
Create Attribute Groups linking the unique identifier to the Contact for each channel.
Store the numeric unique identifier value as a Text data type in data extensions.
questions.e: Se crean Attribute Groups que vinculan el identificador con el Contacto y la clave numérica se guarda como Text.
questions.note: En Dev 3 (P54) aparece marcada: Create Attribute Groups linking the unique identifier to the Contact for each channel..

questions.q: A developer wants to create a Synchronized Data Extension containing Lead data from Sales Cloud. They only want to include records which contain a phone number. Each of the following fields contains this information per these rules: Phone is not blank (Data Type = Phone); PhoneExists is 'true' (Data Type = Boolean); ValidPhone is 'true' (Data Type = Formula(Boolean)); ContactType equals 'Phone' (Data Type = Text). Which field could be used to select a subset of records in the synchronization configuration?
questions.e: Los campos de fórmula no sirven para filtrar la sincronización; se filtra por un campo real como Phone.
questions.note: Marcada D en el set (anotación). Verificar frente a PhoneExists.

questions.q: A developer wants to inject a Contact into a journey using API. What method and route would be used to accomplish this?
questions.e: Un contacto se inyecta en una journey con POST /interaction/v1/events.

questions.q: A developer wants to build out a series of CloudPages that will interact with several REST APIs. Which Marketing Cloud supported scripting tool should be used?
questions.e: SSJS (con Platform/WSProxy) se usa para integrar con APIs REST desde CloudPages.
questions.note: El examinado marcó A, pero la anotación del set es C (SSJS), que es lo correcto para integrar APIs REST desde CloudPages.

questions.q:
A developer wants to expand their knowledge of Query Activities. They want to identify email addresses that have bounced in the last 30 days, along with the Bounce Reason and some additional subscriber specific data; however, the SQL they have written does not return any records.
SELECT s.EmailAddress, s.SubscriberKey, b.JobID, b.EventDate, b.SMTPBounceReason
FROM _Subscribers s JOIN _Bounce b ON s.EmailAddress = b.EmailAddress
WHERE b.EventDate > DateAdd(DAY, -30, GETDATE())
What updates should be made to ensure this SQL statement returns the desired results?
o: Marketing Cloud _Bounce data view does not contain EmailAddress. They should join on SubscriberID.
Marketing Cloud does not allow DateAdd functions in Query Activities. They should define a specific date.
Marketing Cloud does not allow use of GETDATE function. They should define a specific date.
questions.e: El data view _Bounce no tiene EmailAddress: hay que unir por SubscriberID/SubscriberKey.

questions.q: A developer is implementing a custom profile center and using the LogUnsubEvent request. Which required parameter in the Job Context section of the call will successfully record an UnsubEvent?
questions.e: LogUnsubEvent requiere JobID, ListID y BatchID en el contexto del trabajo.

questions.q: A company needs to retrieve a large number of rows from a data extension via the API. Which two solutions would optimize the performance?
o: Use a SimpleFilterPart to retrieve small sets of relevant data.
Use the AMPscript API functions on a CloudPage.
Use the REST API instead of the SOAP API.
questions.e: ContinueRequest recupera lotes sucesivos de resultados; las funciones AMPscript API en CloudPage reducen la carga.
questions.note: Selección del examinado (A y C); el Set 3 anota 'AMPscript API functions on a CloudPage' como respuesta. En Dev 3 (P21) aparece marcada: Use the AMPscript API functions on a CloudPage..

questions.q: A developer wants to set a variable to use a field from a Sendable Data Extension. Which two options could be used in an AMPscript block to set the variable as a 'First Name' field from a Sendable Data Extension used to send the email?
questions.e: AttributeValue("campo") (y [campo] como atributo de perfil) leen un campo de la DE de envío.
questions.note: En Dev 3 (P22) aparece marcada: SET @firstName = AttributeValue("First Name").

questions.q: A developer identified duplicate contacts and wants to delete roughly 10 million subscribers using Contact Delete. How could the process be expedited?
o: Delete any unnecessary Sendable Data Extensions
Manually delete subscribers in All Contacts
Change the Suppression value to a larger value
Stop the current delete process and delete smaller groups
questions.e: Para acelerar un borrado masivo se parte en lotes más pequeños (el límite habitual es de 1 millón por lote).
questions.note: Selección del examinado; sin verificar. En Dev 3 (P23) aparece marcada: Delete any unnecessary Sendable Data Extensions.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters uses an external CRM which only exports encrypted files. They want to use some of the subscriber data found in the CRM for future marketing sends. Which action should be included in an automation given these requirements?
o: File transfer activity to the Import directory for decryption
File transfer activity to the Safehouse for decryption
File drop to the SFTP Root directory
questions.e: Un File Transfer al Safehouse descifra el archivo antes de importarlo.

questions.q: A developer wants to review the available properties for a data extension field using the DataExtensionField SOAP API object. Where could the developer find this information?
o: Open the Object Inspector in the Salesforce Developer Console
Contact Support and request the information
questions.e: Las propiedades de los objetos SOAP se consultan en la documentación del Developer Center.
questions.note: El examinado marcó C, pero la anotación del set es B (documentación oficial).

questions.q: A doctor's office creates Populations for staff, patients, and vendors. What is the maximum number of Populations that should be created to ensure performance?
questions.e: Salesforce recomienda una sola Population para no penalizar el rendimiento.
questions.note: Anotación del set: A (Three); el examinado marcó B. Verificar.

questions.q: A developer wants to design a custom subscription center in CloudPages. The developer prefers to code in AMPscript, but is also skilled in Server-Side JavaScript. While the developer is confident their code is of high quality, they would still like to handle unexpected errors gracefully to ensure the best user experience. Which feature should handle this scenario?
o: Using RaiseError AMPscript function when an error occurs
Marketing Cloud automatically handles any error scenario that may occur
Wrapping the code in an AMPscript HandleError block
Wrapping the code in a Server-Side JavaScript Try/Catch block
questions.e: Un bloque Try/Catch en SSJS captura excepciones y permite una experiencia de usuario controlada.

questions.q: A developer needs to process a payload from an external system in a CloudPage. What Marketing Cloud Server-Side JavaScript Platform function should be used for converting a string payload in JSON format to a JavaScript object?
questions.e: ParseJSON (Platform.Function) convierte una cadena JSON en objeto.

questions.q: A developer is querying data from the _Bounce data view and storing it in a data extension. They have found that sometimes the fields SMTPBounceReason and SMTPCode exceed the 4000-character limits for each field as specified in the DE schema. After consulting with the original requestor, it was decided that they could simply store the first 4000 characters for each of those fields. Which SQL function could be used for this purpose?
questions.e: LEFT(campo, 4000) conserva los primeros 4000 caracteres.
questions.note: El examinado marcó A (RIGHT), pero la anotación es C (LEFT): los PRIMEROS 4000 caracteres.

questions.q: Which two ways would a developer write an Exclusion Script to exclude sending an email at send time when comparing against a Boolean field in the Sendable Data Extension?
questions.e: El script debe devolver un valor booleano; Lookup sobre la DE de exclusiones con SubscriberKey lo consigue.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; los Exclusion Scripts deben devolver true/false (p.ej. Lookup(...) o el campo booleano).

questions.q: A company has chosen to use the REST API for triggered sends, but they continue to get the following error during their testing: "Unable to queue Triggered Send request. There are no valid subscribers." They were informed that the SOAP API provides more information about the error, and found that their payload did not include a required data extension field. Which element of the SOAP API response provides this level of detail?
questions.e: El elemento ErrorDescription del resultado SOAP describe el motivo concreto del fallo.
questions.note: La anotación del set parece C (ErrorCode); el examinado marcó A (ErrorDescription), que es el que describe el detalle del error. Verificar.

questions.q: A developer is working on cross-channel campaign functions for the email team at Northern Trail Outfitters. They are reviewing available APIs for the different Marketing Cloud applications to determine the most appropriate solution for each. Which application utilizes the REST API?
questions.e: Content Builder utiliza la REST API.
questions.note: El examinado marcó B; la anotación del set es C (Content Builder usa la REST API).

questions.q: A developer is writing a query to select unique subscribers who opened any emails sent since the beginning of the previous day. Which query would provide that result?
o: SELECT DISTINCT o.SubscriberKey FROM _Open o INNER JOIN _Job j ON j.JobID = o.JobID WHERE o.SendDate >= CONVERT(date, GETDATE()-1)
SELECT DISTINCT o.SubscriberKey FROM _Open o WHERE o.OpenDate >= CONVERT(date, GETDATE()-1)
SELECT DISTINCT o.SubscriberKey FROM _Open o INNER JOIN _Job j ON j.JobID = o.JobID ...
questions.e: DISTINCT sobre _Open con OpenDate >= ayer devuelve suscriptores únicos.
questions.note: Opción C truncada en la foto; la anotación manuscrita no es legible (examinado marcó B). Verificar.

questions.q: A developer wants to populate a data extension with the date of the most recent click for each subscriber. Which query would accomplish this?
o: SELECT c.SubscriberKey, MAX(c.eventDate) AS eventDate FROM _Click c GROUP BY c.SubscriberKey
SELECT c.SubscriberKey, MIN(c.eventDate) AS eventDate FROM _Click c GROUP BY c.SubscriberKey
SELECT TOP 1 c.SubscriberKey, c.eventDate FROM _Click c ORDER BY c.eventDate DESC
SELECT c.SubscriberKey, c.eventDate FROM _Click c WHERE c.IsUnique = 1
questions.e: MAX(eventDate) agrupado por SubscriberKey da el último clic.

questions.q: A developer, who is new to Marketing Cloud, needs to design a landing page for a new customer. They choose to use Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) due to their extensive knowledge of JavaScript from previous projects. Which feature would the developer be able to leverage in their Server-Side code?
o: Include Try/Catch blocks within the code
questions.e: SSJS admite Try/Catch; no hay DOM ni librerías externas en el servidor.
questions.note: Sin respuesta marcada ni anotada en la foto; C es la opción coherente con SSJS en Marketing Cloud (sin DOM ni librerías externas).

questions.q: A developer needs to create a fully-branded CloudPage which includes images hosted in Content Builder. The developer wants to secure the page and its elements using the SSL protocol. What is the minimum number of SSL certificates required?
questions.e: Se necesitan dos certificados: uno para el dominio de la CloudPage y otro para el de las imágenes de Content Builder.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; sin verificar.

questions.q: Which aspect should a developer consider before creating a Server-to-Server Installed Package and associated API Integration in Marketing Cloud?
o: Using an Installed Package, APIs will have access to resources in all Business Units.
Scope (Permissions) will be granted based on the User who is creating the Installed Package.
Scope (Permissions) must be specifically granted when creating an API Integration component inside an Installed Package.
questions.e: Los permisos (scope) se conceden al crear el componente de integración API del paquete, no por el usuario.

questions.q: A particular data extension needs to be configured to store six months of data. How should data retention be added to the data extension?
o: Import a file to overwrite the rows with six months of data.
Run a query to overwrite the rows with six months of data.
questions.e: La retención se configura en la propia data extension.
questions.note: Anotación manuscrita A; el examinado marcó C.

questions.q: A developer wants to create an AMPscript FOR loop that populates HTML table rows based on the number of rows and data in a target data extension. Where should the developer place the FOR keyword to begin the loop?
questions.e: El FOR empieza antes de <tr> para repetir una fila por registro.

questions.q: A developer is troubleshooting why an API client_id and client_secret are authenticating yet failing to access data from a child business unit. What should be checked to validate the installed package can access the child business unit data?
o: The Installed Package has full Enterprise access to all available child business units
The Installed Package has access to the selected child business unit
The account_id and parent MID are included in the authorization call
questions.e: El paquete debe tener acceso a la unidad de negocio hija seleccionada.
questions.note: Selección del examinado (sin anotación manuscrita). Verificar.

questions.q: A developer needs to find all subscribers on the Customers data extension who made a purchase in the last 30 days. Purchase data is on the Orders data extension which contains a column called 'PurchaseDate'. Contacts are identified in both data extensions by a column called 'ContactKey', and the Orders data extension can contain many instances of the same subscriber. Which SQL keyword should the developer use to achieve the desired result?
questions.e: INNER JOIN combina Customers y Orders; con varias órdenes por cliente conviene DISTINCT.
questions.note: La anotación manuscrita decía C (ORDER BY); INNER JOIN (A) es la opción lógica. Verificar.

questions.q: A developer needs to know how many records are contained in a particular data extension. This will dictate what is displayed on a landing page. Which AMPscript function returns the number of rows in a specified data extension?
questions.e: DataExtensionRowCount devuelve las filas de una DE; RowCount cuenta las de un rowset.
questions.note: La anotación manuscrita dice C (RowCount), pero RowCount cuenta filas de un rowset; DataExtensionRowCount (B) devuelve las filas de una DE. Se usa B.

questions.q: A developer needs to import a file into a data extension which contains transactional data. The file includes a column labeled Purchase_Price with values varying from '$.05' to '$100'. What Data Type should be used to prevent loss of data?
questions.e: Decimal(9,2) conserva los céntimos; Number los truncaría.
questions.note: Sin respuesta marcada en la captura; Decimal(9,2) es la lógica (Number trunca decimales). Verificar.

questions.q: Which action could the RaiseError AMPscript function be configured to perform?
o: Log the source of the error
questions.e: RaiseError puede detener el envío a ese suscriptor o abortar el trabajo y deja constancia del error.
questions.note: Sin respuesta marcada en la captura; no verificado.

questions.q: Which AMPscript function returns the result of interpreted code within a code block and includes the result in the rendered content, where the code block is located?
questions.e: Output() devuelve el resultado interpretado en el punto donde está el bloque de código.
questions.note: La anotación manuscrita dice C, pero la definición corresponde a Output (B). Verificar.

questions.q: A developer receives a request for tracking data for all sends associated with a specific JobID. The developer needs to see Sends, Opens, Clicks, and Bounces. Which two activities could be used?
questions.e: Un SQL Query sobre data views y un File Transfer permiten entregar el tracking de un JobID.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; la combinación habitual sería Tracking Extract + SQL Query (A y B). Verificar. En Dev 4 (P31) aparece marcada: SQL Query Activity.

questions.q: A developer wants to extract tracking data from the Marketing Cloud to an FTP site. A marketer created a Data Extract Activity in the user interface. Which option would be available to extract the data?
questions.e: Un Data Extract creado en la interfaz se ejecuta desde Automation Studio.

questions.q: A developer needs to import a file nightly that will be used for multiple SQL Query Activities. The file could arrive any time between 2 a.m. and 5 a.m., and one of the requirements is that there is a unique file name for each import, rather than overwriting the file on the FTP site. Which action should be configured?
questions.e: Un File Drop Automation arranca cuando llega el archivo con el patrón de nombre, sea cual sea la hora.
questions.note: La anotación manuscrita dice B; pero un archivo que llega en una ventana horaria con nombre único encaja con File Drop Automation (A). Verificar.

questions.q: A developer needs to add From Addresses to Marketing Cloud and wants to ensure they are verified before being used for sending. Which two routes would allow this?
questions.e: La verificación de dominios usa rutas /messaging/v1/domainverification (incluida la inserción masiva).
questions.note: Selección del examinado; podría no ser exacta. Verificar en la documentación de Domain Verification API. En Dev 4 (P52) aparece marcada: POST /messaging/v1/domainverification/bulk/insert.

questions.q: A developer is configuring a new Marketing Cloud account and has decided to use a unique 10-digit integer as each customer's Contact Key. Which data type should be used when representing the value of Contact Key?
questions.e: Un identificador numérico largo se guarda como Text para evitar pérdidas y problemas de formato.

questions.q: A developer built a complex dynamic email with many data variants. Rather than create test data manually, they want to use a subset of live data to validate the dynamic aspects of the email. Which SQL function should be used to collect a representative sample from a larger data set?
questions.e: NTILE reparte filas en tramos y permite tomar una muestra representativa.
questions.note: La anotación manuscrita dice B (OVER); NTILE (C) es la función de muestreo por tramos. Verificar.

questions.q: A developer is building a landing page in Marketing Cloud and an email with a Call-To-Action (CTA) link. The landing page will display personal information about the subscriber. In which way could the developer create the CTA link?
o: Append EmailAddress to the URL as an encoded parameter.
Append SubscriberKey to the URL as an encoded parameter.
questions.e: CloudPagesURL cifra los parámetros del enlace, evitando exponer datos personales.

questions.q: A developer initiated a batch delete of Contacts in Contact Builder due to an import error during implementation. There are over two million records that need to be deleted. Which two factors should be considered when batch deleting large volumes of contacts?
o: The deletion process supersedes other automated account activities.
To more quickly remove contact information, use the suppression period length of 14.
Up to one million records can be deleted in each batch.
The suppression status does not show for individual contacts until the entire batch processes.
questions.e: Se procesan hasta un millón de registros por lote, y el estado de supresión no aparece hasta acabar el lote.

questions.q: A marketing director at Northern Trail Outfitters wants to analyze the Send, Click, and Open Data Views. Which activities should the developer build to generate the data before transferring it to the SFTP?
questions.e: Se generan datos con Query sobre data views y se extraen con Data Extension Extract.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; lo habitual es Query Activity > Data Extension Extract (opción C). Verificar.

questions.q: Which two AMPscript HTTP functions allow an OAuth token to be passed in a header?
questions.e: HTTPGet y HTTPPost (y sus variantes) admiten cabeceras personalizadas como Authorization.

questions.q: Customer data has been imported into a staging data extension and needs to be normalized before adding into the master data extension. A text field named 'birthday' contains date values in various formats. Some of the values are valid dates, but some are not. Which SQL keywords and functions could be used to write the query?
questions.e: Se combinan CASE, ISDATE y CAST/CONVERT para convertir solo las fechas válidas.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters uses a numeric identifier for Subscriber Key. Customer data is stored in a data extension with the Subscriber Key set as a Primary Key. Which step is required when creating relationships for this data extension in Data Designer?
o: Link the Contact ID to the Subscriber Key when creating the relationship
Use a one-to-one cardinality when creating the relationship
Set Subscriber Key as a text data type before linking the data extension to Contact Key
Link the Contact Key to the Subscriber's email address when creating the relationship
questions.e: El modelo se vincula por clave: la clave numérica del Subscriber Key debe enlazarse con el Contact Key.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; podría ser "Set Subscriber Key as Text" (ver pregunta de Attribute Groups). Verificar.

questions.q: A developer uses an API to send data to a Marketing Cloud data extension once every five minutes using the REST API. They notice data does not always write to the data extension, leading to data loss. Which three best practices would be recommended to avoid this issue?
o: Use Username and Password authentication instead of oAuth client ID and client secret.
In case of 'Not Authorized' errors, request a new Access Token and attempt the call again.
In case of Server errors, request a new Access Token before each request.
In case of Server errors, ensure the Server is available and attempt the call again.
Store the expiry of the access token to ensure a new token is requested if the old one is invalid.
questions.e: Reintentar con nuevo token ante "Not Authorized", reintentar ante errores del servidor y guardar la caducidad del token evitan pérdida de datos.

questions.q: A developer wants CloudPages to work with a REST API returning data in JavaScript Object Notation. The developer wants to efficiently ingest the data and write it to a data extension. Which function should be used?
questions.e: ParseJSON de SSJS convierte la respuesta JSON en objeto para escribirla en la DE.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters sends a weekly email with dynamic content, and they want to record custom data inside a send log on each send to record what content was displayed and correlation flags. What is the maximum number of custom data points recommended by Salesforce to ensure sends speeds are not affected when inserting into the built-in send log?
questions.e: Salesforce recomienda mantener pocos campos personalizados en el Send Log (unos 10 o menos) para no ralentizar el envío.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; Salesforce recomienda limitar los campos personalizados del Send Log (≈ 10 o menos). Posible respuesta correcta: D.

questions.q: Northern Trails Outfitters (NTO) has a sendable data extension with 1,500,000 contact records they want to delete. Which step is required before deleting the contacts?
o: Query the records into a new sendable data extension and delete it
Navigate to Email Studio and delete the data extension
Navigate to Contact Builder and delete the data extension
Divide the records in half and delete each resulting data extension
questions.e: El borrado por lote tiene un máximo de 1 millón de registros: se divide en partes.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; relacionado con el límite de 1 millón de contactos por lote de borrado (ver q1). Verificar.

questions.q: A developer wants to include a comment within an AMPscript code block for the benefit of other developers who will be reviewing the code. Which syntax should be used?
questions.e: Los comentarios de AMPscript usan /* ... */.

questions.q: A field value returned from a data extension lookup contains a tab-delimited list of values. Which AMPscript function could easily determine if a specific text string exists anywhere in the list?
questions.e: IndexOf devuelve la posición de una cadena dentro de otra (0 si no está).
questions.note: Selección del examinado fue A (BuildRowSetFromString); IndexOf (C) devuelve la posición de la cadena y es la opción más directa. Se usa C.

questions.q: A marketer is planning a weekly promotional send. Which two types of data extensions could be sent to?
questions.e: Se puede enviar a una Sendable Data Extension o a una Salesforce Data Extension.

questions.q: A developer wants to create a Send Log Data Extension to increase efficiency with tracking email sends. Which two best practices should be utilized when configuring the Send Log Data Extension?
o: Limit custom fields in the data extension to 10 or fewer.
Maximize the field size to accommodate all incoming data.
Create a number of fields equal to the fields in the source data extension.
Use Data Retention to limit the amount of data captured.
questions.e: El Send Log debe tener pocos campos personalizados (10 o menos) y retención de datos para no crecer sin límite.
questions.note: Selección del examinado (10 o menos + campo máximo); la práctica recomendada también incluye data retention. Verificar.

questions.q: A developer started a Contact Delete process that is now complete. In which two places would the Contact Delete process remove data?
o: Import Files on the Enhanced SFTP
questions.e: Contact Delete elimina datos en data extensions enviables/contactos y archivos de importación.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; sin verificar.

questions.q: A developer wants to create an HTML table where rows will alternate background colors between white and red. The developer does not know how many rows will be sent within each email, and decides to use a loop and assigns the RowCount() of the table rows to the variable @numerator. What AMPscript logic should be used to determine the background color of each table row within the loop?
o: %%[ IF DIVIDE(@numerator,2) = 1 THEN SET @color = 'Red' ELSE SET @color = 'White' ENDIF ]%%
%%[ IF MOD(@numerator,2) = 1 THEN SET @color = 'Red' ELSE SET @color = 'White' ENDIF ]%%
%%[ IF @numerator/2 = 1 THEN SET @color = 'Red' ELSE SET @color = 'White' ENDIF ]%%
%%[ IF SUBSTRING(DIVIDE(@numerator,2),1) = 1 THEN SET @color = 'Red' ELSE SET @color = 'White' ENDIF ]%%
questions.e: MOD(@numerator,2) devuelve el resto y permite alternar filas pares/impares.
questions.note: El examinado marcó A (DIVIDE); la lógica correcta para alternar es MOD (resto de la división). Se usa B.

questions.q: An UpdateDE AMPscript function is used to update a column value in a data extension row when an email is sent. The email is being sent to 250,000 subscribers, but the user decides to cancel the send during the sending process and only 400 emails are sent. How many subscriber rows would be affected by the UpdateDE function?
o: 400 subscribers who were sent the email
Only subscribers who exist in All Subscribers
questions.e: UpdateDE se ejecuta por suscriptor procesado: solo se actualizan los 400 a los que llegó el envío.

questions.q: A developer is managing the data model programmatically and needs to access Attribute Group schema via the API. Which API should be used?
questions.e: El esquema de Attribute Groups se consulta por API; la respuesta marcada es SOAP.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; el esquema de Attribute Groups suele leerse por REST (Contacts API). Verificar.

questions.q: A marketer is sending an email with dynamic content contained in a series of conditionals. Which AMPscript function should be used to track the different versions of the content within the email?
questions.e: BeginImpressionRegion/EndImpressionRegion miden las versiones de contenido dinámico.

questions.q: A developer wants to personalize a welcome email with the recipient's first name from the Customers data extension, which is different from the targeted sending data extension named NewSubscribers. Both data extensions contain the unique identifier in a field named CustomerKey. Which AMPscript Syntax would populate the first name personalization as requested?
questions.e: Lookup("DE","campo devuelto","campo de búsqueda",valor) con el valor sin comillas (CustomerKey).
questions.note: El examinado marcó B (con el valor entre comillas, que busca la cadena literal); la sintaxis correcta es D.

questions.q: A developer is making an API REST call to trigger an email send. An access token is used to authenticate the call. How long are Marketing Cloud v2 access tokens valid?
o: Each API call requires a new access token.
REST calls do not require an access token.
questions.e: Los tokens de acceso de Marketing Cloud caducan a los 20 minutos.
questions.note: El examinado marcó B (24 h); los tokens v2 de Marketing Cloud caducan a los 20 minutos (A). Se usa A.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to use Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data to personalize email communications, but does not want to store PII data in Marketing Cloud. Which feature could they use to personalize emails from an external data source?
questions.e: Tokenized Sending permite personalizar con PII de un sistema externo sin almacenarla en Marketing Cloud.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to trigger a receipt email via the SOAP API whenever a customer makes a purchase. Their developer wrote the call using the TriggeredSendDefinition object and the Create method, but no emails have been sent during his initial testing. Which object and method should the developer use?
questions.e: El envío se dispara creando un objeto TriggeredSend (no TriggeredSendDefinition).

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is using a mobile campaign to collect email addresses of interested subscribers. Using AMPscript's API functions they will send a confirmation email when an email is texted into their short code. Which two objects are required to successfully create a TriggeredSend object?
questions.e: Un TriggeredSend requiere un Subscriber y una TriggeredSendDefinition.

questions.q: A developer needs to determine why a Query Activity in an Automation has failed. Which three scenarios could have caused this?
o: The query takes more than 60 minutes to run.
The query is inserting a value that is larger than the size of a field.
The query is not returning a value for a non-nullable field.
The query is returning more than one million rows.
The query results in duplicate rows not allowed by the primary key.
questions.e: Un query falla si el valor excede el tamaño del campo, no llena un campo obligatorio o duplica una clave primaria.

questions.q: A developer wants to trigger an SMS message to a subscriber using a form published on CloudPages. How should the SMS message be triggered once the subscriber submits the form?
o: requestToken and messageContact REST API objects
InsertData AMPscript function to add the subscriber to a MobileConnect list
Outbound SMS template and Automation Send Method
questions.e: Para SMS desde CloudPages se obtiene un token y se llama a messageContact (MobileConnect).

questions.q: A developer wants to programmatically inject Contacts into a journey via the REST API. What route using POST data extension fields and values should be used?
questions.e: POST /interaction/v1/events inyecta contactos a una journey.

questions.q: Cloud Kicks would like to encrypt and store form data submitted from a CloudPage in a data extension using AMPscript. Which three encryption options could be used when creating a new key in Key Management?
questions.e: En Key Management hay claves simétricas, asimétricas y de salt para cifrar datos con AMPscript.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to exclude sends to specific subscribers based on a business rule, which is defined in an Exclusion Script. Which three types of sends would support this functionality?
o: Send Marketing Cloud Email in Sales or Service Cloud
questions.e: Los exclusion scripts funcionan en Send Flow, Email Send de Automation Studio y Journey Builder.

questions.q: A developer is building an integration using the Marketing Cloud API. Which configuration should be used for the API integration component in the associated Installed Package?
o: Select the 'Admin-approved users are pre-authorized' option under Permitted Users.
Select all available options to enable package reuse for future integrations.
Select the minimum required scope for the integration.
Select the 'Require Secret for Web Server Flow' option.
questions.e: Se aplica el mínimo privilegio: se seleccionan solo los scopes necesarios.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is reconsidering the requirement to have English, Spanish, and French versions of their email campaigns. They request a developer to create a query which aggregates clicks grouped by language of the recipient. Language is stored in a Profile Attribute. Which two Data Views would be included in the query?
questions.e: Se une _Click con _Subscribers (donde está el atributo de idioma) y se agrupa por idioma.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; un atributo de perfil de suscriptor se consulta vía _Subscribers y _Click. Verificar.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to determine the best identifier for subscribers across all channels. What should be recommended?
questions.e: Contact Key es el identificador único y consistente entre canales.

questions.q: A developer uses the messageDefinitionSends REST API endpoint to send a triggered send email. This method returns a 202 (success) response code. How could the developer validate if the email was successfully sent?
o: Confirm the record was successfully inserted into the associated Triggered Send Data Extension.
Use the validateEmail REST resource with POST method to obtain the email delivery details from the request.
Use the messageDefinitionSends/key:{key}/deliveryRecords REST endpoint with GET method.
The 202 response code indicates the message was sent successfully; no further action is required.
questions.e: El 202 solo indica que se aceptó la petición; el estado se verifica con deliveryRecords.

questions.q: A developer is using the legacy endpoint www.exacttargetapis.com and has been asked to switch to Tenant Specific Endpoints (TSEs). What is a benefit of switching to TSEs?
o: Gain access to TSE-specific REST routes
API calls will no longer fail
questions.e: Los endpoints específicos de subdominio (TSE) mejoran el rendimiento y la seguridad.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters uses a Send Log and sends more than one million emails per day. They want to execute daily reports on all subscriber activity without impacting send performance. Which set of best practices should be implemented?
o: Add a data retention policy to the Send Log, then run reports from the _Opens data view.
Add a data retention policy to the Send Log, then run reports from the Send Log data extension.
Copy new Send Log records to an Archive data extension, then run reports from the Send Log data extension.
Copy new Send Log records to an Archive data extension, then run reports from the Archive data extension.
questions.e: Se copia el Send Log a una DE de archivo y los informes se ejecutan sobre el archivo, sin afectar al envío.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is using an asynchronous SOAP API call to the TriggeredSend object to send order confirmation emails to their customers. Which API object and attribute should be used to retrieve the status of the API call?
questions.e: En SOAP asíncrono el estado se recupera con ResultItem y el RequestID.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; sin verificar.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters uses data extensions to manage the subscriber information used for their email sends, and those sends include calls to update records with new or different subscriber information. The developer handling these records writes some AMPscript to check and see if the data extension containing those records updated using an InsertDE() call if the record doesn't yet exist. Why would the developer receive an error stating the application cannot insert a duplicate value for the primary key in the data extension?
o: The InsertDE function comes after the system added the row as part of the email send.
The InsertDE function will always insert two rows into a data extension as part of the call.
The InsertDE function cannot be used with name and value pairs.
The InsertDE function cannot be used at send time.
questions.e: El error de clave duplicada aparece porque el sistema ya añadió la fila durante el envío antes del InsertDE.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; sin verificar.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the IF statement below? %%[ SET @rows = LookupRows('DEName','SubscriberKey',_SubscriberKey) IF RowCount(@rows) > 0 THEN SET @row = row(@rows) SET @image = Field(@row,'image') ]%% %%[ ELSE ]%% %%[ ENDIF ]%%
o: To handle when the subscriber is in a held status
To handle when there are multiple records in the data extension for the subscriber
To handle when images are broken
To handle when no row is returned by the LookupRows function
questions.e: El ELSE cubre el caso en que LookupRows no devuelve filas (imagen por defecto).
questions.note: El examinado marcó B; la rama ELSE (imagen por defecto) cubre el caso en que LookupRows no devuelve filas (D).

questions.q:
A developer wants to create a CloudPage which is linked from an email.
%%[
SET @point = RequestParameter(x)
SET @value = 5
IF Length(@point) > 1 THEN SET @value = 1
ELSEIF Length(@point) > 2 THEN SET @value = 2
ELSEIF Length(@point) > 3 THEN SET @value = 3
ELSEIF Length(@point) > 4 THEN SET @value = 4
ENDIF
]%%
What is the expected value of @value if x = 'Tacos'?
questions.e: "Tacos" tiene 5 caracteres; el primer IF (> 1) es cierto y el resto no se evalúa: @value = 1.

questions.q: A developer wants to build an audience by identifying subscribers who opened a specific email. Which query should be used?
questions.e: Se consulta _Open filtrando por JobID y se devuelve SubscriberKey.

questions.q: A developer wants to use the RaiseError AMPscript function when a subscriber does not have the necessary data to build an email. Which two outcomes are possible using this function?
o: The email is not sent to the particular subscriber.
An error message is sent to the From Address used in the email.
questions.e: RaiseError puede omitir el envío al suscriptor o hacer fallar el trabajo completo.

questions.q: A developer is configuring a File Drop Automation and wants to use a Filename Pattern to allow for timestamps on the file. The file name will always start with the month and day (e.g. MAY15) the file is dropped onto the SFTP site. Which two configurations should be used for the automation to successfully start?
questions.e: Se usa el operador "Begins With" y el patrón %%Month%%%%Day%%.

questions.q: A developer wants to include an AMPscript If/Else statement in an email to satisfy the condition "if the subscriber's tier is not premier then display heading encouraging them to upgrade." The tier value has already been set as a variable named @level. How should the developer write this AMPscript conditional statement?
o: %%=IIF(@level = 'premier','You are a premier member!','Upgrade to premier now!')=%%
%%=IF(@level IS 'premier','Upgrade to premier now!','You are a premier member!')=%%
%%=IIF(@level == 'premier','You are a premier member!','Upgrade to premier now!')=%%
%%=IF(@level == 'premier') THEN 'Upgrade to premier now!' ELSE 'You are a premier member!' ENDIF=%%
questions.e: IIF es la función inline: IIF(@level == "premier", texto1, texto2).
questions.note: Selección del examinado. Nota: IIF es la función inline; IF...THEN no se puede usar así dentro de %%=...=%%.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has created subscriber attributes including AGE under Profile Manager within their Enterprise 2.0 account. How would a developer retrieve subscribers over 30 years of age?
o: The data cannot be retrieved with a query
Create a filtered Group of subscribers with AGE more than 30
Create a query that references the _EnterpriseAttribute data view
Create a query that references the _Subscribers data view
questions.e: Los atributos de perfil se consultan en el data view _EnterpriseAttribute.
questions.note: El examinado marcó "grupo filtrado"; el SQL sobre _EnterpriseAttribute es lo coherente. Verificar.

questions.q: A developer is leveraging the SOAP API to dynamically display Profile and Preference Attributes in a custom profile center. Which method could be used to support the dynamic functionality?
questions.e: El método Describe devuelve los atributos de perfil y preferencias disponibles.

questions.q: A developer wants a link to be dynamic based on subscriber attributes. Rather than create numerous links, the developer uses AMPscript to set the link's value as a variable. The variable will be used within the <a> tag. What should the developer do within the <a> tag to ensure clicks are tracked for the variable?
o: Include a variable for the Alias attribute
Wrap the variable in a v function
Wrap the variable in a RedirectTo function
questions.e: RedirectTo envuelve el valor para que el clic quede registrado en el tracking.

questions.q: A developer is experiencing timeouts when testing a SQL Query Activity in Automation Studio. How should the developer optimize the query?
o: Configure a longer timeout period within Administration in Automation Studio.
Use intermediate tables to break queries into smaller parts.
Limit joins to the INNER JOIN within all SQL Query Activities.
Ensure all SQL Query Activities are in the same step in the automation.
questions.e: Dividir la consulta en tablas intermedias evita el timeout de 30 minutos.

questions.q: A customer wants a list of subscribers who were sent an email within the past 12 months. How should this request be completed?
o: Locate the email sends in the Tracking tab within Email Studio
Query against the _Job and _Sent data views
Run a tracking extract via the SOAP API
Create a measure with criteria sent_date is after today minus 365 days
questions.e: El tracking extract devuelve los envíos pasados; los data views solo guardan unos seis meses.
questions.note: Selección del examinado. Verificar.

questions.q: A developer needs to display a value which has been calculated using an AMPscript block. This value is stored in the variable named 'Label'. Which two ways should the developer display this value in the body of an email?
questions.e: Se muestran con %%=v(@Label)=%% o con <ctrl:var name=@Label />.

questions.q: Which activity is required before a compressed file can be imported?
questions.e: Un File Transfer descomprime el archivo en la SFTP antes de importarlo.
questions.note: Selección del examinado; File Transfer (Decompress) es la actividad que descomprime. Verificar.
